notes.title: It’s Here — Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream Has Launched!
notes.notes:
[p]This is it. After years of dreaming, fighting, and memeing, [b]Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream is officially out on Steam today![/b][/p][p]From a small team in Indonesia to this surreal moment — we couldn’t have gotten here without you. Thank you for being part of this journey. 💖[/p][previewyoutube="g6pKcDioTt0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]What Awaits in Beyond Dream[/h2][list][*][p]🏙️ [b]A wilder South Jayakarta[/b] – A denser city packed with absurd side stories, offbeat activities, and mini-games that are even more unhinged than the last time.[/p][/*][*][p]👊 [b]Jordan & Budi, two styles of chaos[/b] – Your favs are back with an upgraded combat system that slaps (hard).[/p][/*][*][p]🎸 [b]Rock out with Beyond Dream[/b] – Story moments, rhythm sections, and a chance to actually take the stage with the band.[/p][/*][/list][p]To celebrate, Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream is [b]20% off for a limited time[/b]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479770/Troublemaker_2_Beyond_Dream/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]💞 [b]How You Can Support Us[/b][/p][p]As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[/p][list][*][p]If you buy the game, please consider leaving an [b]honest review on Steam[/b]! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games, and we’d love to hear your thoughts and experiences.[/p][/*][*][p]Share the game with friends, family, or your followers on social media. A simple post or chat can help others discover their next favorite adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/3apmxVuhKu"]Discord [/url]to hang out with the community and share the chaos.[/p][/*][/list][p]The dream is no longer just a dream — it’s playable, it’s chaotic, and it’s here. We can’t wait to see your reviews, memes, and clips. [/p][p]
Dare to Dream! Beyond Dream!
Stay Tune, Stay UwU[/p][p]-The Gamecom Team[/p]

notes.title: The wait is almost over!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone – what a whirlwind yesterday was![/p][p]We just wrapped up our very first Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream media event, and we couldn't be more excited to finally share this with you![/p][p][/p][h1][b]🗓️ Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream launches on Steam September 15![/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="aeU4lnorcXE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is the sequel we’ve always wanted to make — one that’s bigger, bolder, and weirder in the best ways possible. Being a small team from Indonesia, we never could’ve imagined hosting an event like this when we first made the original [i]Troublemaker[/i].[/p][p]Seeing the response has been surreal — thank you for being part of it![/p][p][/p][p]Teenagers, Dreams, and Drugs. Discover the secrets of South Jayakarta city, set two years  after the ending of the original Troublemaker. The journey of the “Parakacuk” gang continues alongside the “Beyond Dream” band in South Jayakarta city in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s new in Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]🏙️ [b]A bigger, denser South Jayakarta[/b] – Packed with absurd side stories, city activities, and a whole bunch of ridiculous mini-games. (Yes, they’re even more unhinged than the last time.)[/p][p]🎭 [b]A wild and weird narrative[/b] – Set two years after the first game, the story dives into dreams, drugs, and chasing meaning with the Parakacuk gang and the “Beyond Dream” band.[/p][p]👊 [b]Two playable characters, two fighting styles[/b] – Jordan and Budi bring their own flavor of chaos to an upgraded combat system that hits harder and plays smoother.[/p][p]💬 [b]Signature Gamecom satire[/b] – The local comedy and sharp commentary are back and just as loud as ever.[/p][p]🎸 [b]Oh — and yes, you can actually play in the band- [/b]We’ve got rhythm sections, story moments, and more where you and the [i]Beyond Dream[/i] crew take the stage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Haven’t wishlisted the game yet? Do it now so you don’t miss the launch on September 15![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479770/Troublemaker_2_Beyond_Dream/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The team is still catching our breath after everything that went down yesterday — hahaha.[/p][p]Turns out hosting our very first event came with a lot of moving parts 😅
[/p][p]But! We managed to document it all![/p][p]🎥 [b]Check out the wrap-up of our media event here:[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gfx-ro5tUpg"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks so much for being part of this journey — we’ll be sharing more in the weeks leading up to launch. Until then...[/p][p][/p][p]Dare to Dream! Beyond Dream! 
Stay Tune, Stay UwU 
-The Gamecom Team [/p]
